sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: strong comfort-food appeal. A very real reason people like them, even if the nutrition fit is weak. Still retains some tuber identity. Not nutritionally empty, just much worse than stronger tuber forms. Satisfying texture and taste. Part of the real-world appeal, especially for content framing.
